ORDINANCE



BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1. The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the RS-2,
Residential Single-Unit (Detached House) Districts symbols and indications as shown on
Map No. 26-G in the area bound by:

      the alley next south of and parallel to West 91st Street and extended west where
      no alley exists; South Beverly Avenue; the alley next south of and parallel to
      West 93rd Place and extended west where no street exists; the west right-of-way
      line of the Pennsylvania Railroad; West 93rd Street; the west right-of-way line of
      South Vanderpole Avenue; and the Chicago, Rock Island and Pacific Railroad,

to those of a POS-1, Parks and Open Space District,

SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.




                                                            ____________________________
                                                                Matthew J. O’Shea
                                                                Alderman, 19th Ward




Common Addresses:

8859 S. Beverly Avenue
9415 S. Charles Avenue
